source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of function call management (PDF 99).

blocks.text: Stacks function calls sambhalte hain. Socheye aap baari baari phone calls kar rahe hain: har call par naam notepad ke oopar likhte hain (push), aur call khatam hone par kaat dete hain (pop). Programming mein jab function bulaya jata hai to us ki tafseel, jaise kya karna hai aur baad mein kahan lautna hai, call stack par push hoti hai; khatam hone par pop hoti hai, ta ke computer jane ke aage kya karna hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar main() f() ko aur f() g() ko bulaye to woh kis tarteeb mein khatam hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Pehle g(), phir f(), phir main(): aakhri call pehle khatam hoti hai (LIFO).

items: Har function call call stack par push aur lautne par pop hoti hai.
